sources.note: ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists certification info, pricing disclaimer, and key features including scheduling, CPOE, e-prescribing, medication reconciliation, lab results, patient portal, telemedicine, HCC/MRA scoring, MIPS/PQRS, and HIPAA compliance. Links to EHI export and API documentation.

Homepage. Describes MDFlow as having 10+ years experience. Lists three products: EHR, Care Management System, and Hospitalist Management System. Also offers telemedicine and HIT consulting. References Community Medical Group (18 centers, 70k patients). HITRUST CSF certified.

Seven client testimonials. Community Medical Group praises customizability and efficiency. Others mention case/disease management, data analytics, chart review for risk adjustment, and user-friendly interface.

Hospitalist Management System (separate product). AI-powered, cloud-based platform for hospitalist groups. Includes patient intake, charge capture, eligibility verification, credentialing, clinical documentation, billing/RCM, mobile portal, and telemedicine. Built on Microsoft technology.

Care Management System (separate product). NCQA Pre-validated population health and case management software. Features include candidate identification, health risk assessments, care plans, medication management, compliance tracking, analytics. Integrates with lab data, claims, pharmacy, hospital ADT feeds.

News page. Key items: HITRUST certification (Aug 2022), NCQA Pre-validation (Sep 2019), partnerships with Freedom Health/Optimum Healthcare/Solis Health Plans/Cano Health/Carisk Partners. Product launches: MDTrans (Jan 2018), mobile app (Aug 2017), telemedicine platform (Mar 2016).

Archived MDFlow marketing document. Describes EHR v5.0 features including CPOE, e-prescribing with drug interaction checking, medication reconciliation, formulary compliance, lab integration, immunization registry, document management, HCC management, patient portal, scheduling, HEDIS/Star Ratings, health information exchange (HL7/CCDA/CCD/CCR).
Florida LLC registration. MDFlow EHR, LLC incorporated October 10, 2014. Located at 7715 NW 48th Street, Miami, FL 33166.
Leidos usability test report for MDFlow EHR v8 (March 2025). PDF could not be parsed during research, but its existence confirms Leidos as the ONC-ACB testing lab.
